summary: Swvl Holdings, a Dubai-based BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K confirming closings of previously announced private placements. Coefficient SWVL Holdings, LLC closed September 1, 2026, and HITE closed September 2, 2026, covering 8,990,317 Class A ordinary shares at $1.446 per share; Sofico Holdings Limited closed September 10, 2026, for 1,027,397 shares at $1.46. HITE instead purchased pre-funded warrants for 2,047,668 shares with a $0.001 exercise price, exercisable until fully exercised. Securities were exempt from registration and incorporated by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. Watch potential overhang and dilution from warrant exercise and resale registration.
